question: Should the repair lane adopt this PR’s stricter fail-closed request-boundary contract now, including pausing mutations and deferred publication whenever freshness, authorization, checks, receipts, or renewed state credentials cannot be proven?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but the balance between preventing stale authoritative writes and increasing repair-lane pauses or requeues is an operational security and availability policy choice that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Approve guarded rollout
options.body: Require exact-head canary evidence, then merge the coordinated guards and monitor repair close, merge, receipt, and deferred-publication outcomes.

options.title: Narrow the first rollout
options.body: Land target, covering-PR, and required-check mutation guards first while deferring credential-renewal or receipt coupling to a follow-up.

options.title: Pause the contract change
options.body: Keep the merged review-activity protection from https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/557 and defer broader fail-closed mutation enforcement.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded rollout
recommendation.body: Require exact-head canary evidence, then merge the coordinated guards and monitor repair close, merge, receipt, and deferred-publication outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged and proposed history identifies this person as the owner of both the review-activity foundation and the broader repair-mutation boundary implementation.
